question: When are property taxes due, and how do I pay them?

nuggets.text: Real property tax is due in two installments, March 31 and September 15.

nuggets.text: A penalty and interest are added to unpaid tax.
nuggets.quote: (c) If at any time after [July 1, 1987], any real property tax, or any installment of real property tax, is not paid within the time prescribed, there shall be added to the real property tax or installment a penalty of 10% of the unpaid amount plus simple interest on the unpaid amount at the rate of 1-1/2% per month or portion of a month until the real property tax or installment is paid.
